main_text.p: mium Dalila, Iud.14. 16. Nimium Anna vx-xor Tobiæ, Tob.2. Nimium vxor Iobi, Iob.2. Nimium Michol filia Saul, 2.Reg. 6. Nimium Iezabel vxor Achabi, 3.Reg.21. Nimium vxor imperatoris Valentis, quæ sua blandiloquentia maritum ad Arianas partes traxit, vt habetur lib.7. Eccles.hist.cap.12.
Aliter autem se gesserunt, & multo lauda-bilius Anna vxor Elcanæ, 1 Reg.1. Abigail v-xor Nabalis, 1.Reg.25. Maria mater Domini, Matth.1.Luc.2.Ioan. 2.

Tertia virtus, quæ ornat mulierem magis quàm smaragdus aut purpura, teste etiam Cratete Thebano, est pudicitia, seu verecundia, qua ornata fuit Susanna, Dan.13. Nam multiplex gratia, vel, gratia super gratiam, in quit noster Sapiens, est mulier pudica & fidelis .i. quum summus mulieris pudor (quo cauet omnem in dictis & factis turpitudinê, ex eaque hominum, in primisque mariti offensionem) cum fidelitate (quę in rebus commissis creditisq; verfatur) coniungitur, nec vlla re digne poteft rependi eius animi con-tinentia: qua nimirum se continet non tantùm à Venere, sed etiam à vino & multiloquio, discurfu, auaritia. Continentia enim genus est ad quamplurimas suas species. Vt autem pudicitia, quæ ex continenti animo proficiscitur, decet mulierem: sic mores, fermones & gestus obscoeni atq; turpes illam dedecent.
Quarta est, honestas seu bonitas. Dicit e-nim:

page.notes: The word after "quit" is printed as "quit" and may be a misprint for another word; kept as printed. "lua" in "quæ lua blandiloquentia" is a long s, read as "sua" and transcribed accordingly; the letter is not fully certain. "turpitudinê" has a doubtful final vowel mark. Line-end word "fide-lis" has no printed hyphen and is written whole. Short marks at the right edge and a stroke below the last line are not text and were left out.
